On this week’s Overtime, we talk Magic Mouse vs. MX Master, the smart glasses everyone keeps asking about, and what Jeff found when he tested the HomePod mini 2’s latency. Then we get into the best Black Friday Apple deals, like AirPods Pro 3 for $149 and why you should skip the MacBook Neo for a $999 MacBook Air.
